Read the receive operator `<-` and the reading beside its word.

```go
value := <-results
```

```go
// A long comment whose words are separated by spaces, so that a wrapping reader sees it break at a space while a scrolling reader scrolls the box sideways to reach its end: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen sixteen seventeen eighteen nineteen twenty.
```

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <ruby>辞書<rt>じしょ</rt></ruby> | dictionary |

The reading size reaches the note below.[^1]

[^1]: The footnote follows the reading size.
